exposure: Gestational carrier BMI categories: healthy weight (20-24.9 kg/m2), overweight (25-29.9 kg/m2), and obese (30-35 kg/m2)
BMI categories: healthy weight (20-24.9 kg/m2), overweight (25-29.9 kg/m2), and obese (30-35 kg/m2)
cohort: Gestational carriers undergoing donated oocytes and assisted reproductive technology (n=163)
finding: Increasing obesity in gestational carriers undergoing IVF with donated oocytes did not impair reproductive outcomes, as clinical pregnancy and live birth rates remained similar across BMI groups.
